verdict.rationale: TaxJar mentions a 'guarantee' backing AutoFile's on-time filings, implying some accountability for filing accuracy/deadlines, but there is no documented accuracy guarantee for tax calculations themselves, no audit support commitment, and no details on terms, coverage, or remediation if a calculation is wrong. Missing for 10: explicit calculation-accuracy guarantee, audit support/defense commitment, terms/conditions of any guarantee, and independent verification of the guarantee being honored.
